title: Lace Fitted Sleeve Sheath Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at the next wedding in this elegant sheath dress! Featuring delicate lace fitted sleeves and a figure-flattering silhouette, this timeless piece is perfect for celebrating love in style. Effortlessly chic and sophisticated, it's your go-to for unforgettable moments!

 

Size Tips: Prioritize selecting based on bust and waist measurements.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Fitted sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
